title: She time travelled to meet her 25 year old self

lines.tts: [intrigued] Asha built a time machine... to visit herself at twenty-five.
lines.text: Asha built a time machine... to visit herself at twenty-five.

lines.tts: [warm, a little shaky] Hi, sweetheart. It's me. You. Fifty years later.
lines.text: Hi, sweetheart. It's me. You. Fifty years later.

lines.tts: [shocked, excited] No way! So... did we open the bakery?!
lines.text: No way! So... did we open the bakery?!

lines.tts: [quiet, sad] ...No. We kept waiting to be ready.
lines.text: No. We kept waiting to be ready.

lines.tts: Ready after the course. After the savings. After the perfect recipe.
lines.text: Ready after the course. After the savings. After the perfect recipe.

lines.tts: [soft, bitter] Ready never came. Ready is a damn lie.
lines.text: Ready never came. Ready is a damn lie.

lines.tts: [quiet, small] So... what do I do?
[firm, warm] Bake one tray. Today. Sell it to your neighbors.
lines.text: Bake one tray. Today. Sell it to your neighbors.

lines.tts: [warm, building] So she did. Twelve cookies. Eleven sold. Then a hundred. Then a shop.
lines.text: So she did. Twelve cookies. Eleven sold. Then a hundred. Then a shop.

lines.tts: [emotional] The best time to start was years ago. The second best time is today.
lines.text: The best time to start was years ago. The second best time is today.

lines.tts: [surprised, delighted laugh] Oh! I own a bakery now!
lines.text: Oh! I own a bakery now!
